# Build Your First MCP in 3 Hours

Code for the TAI Labs live workshop (19 October 2026). You build an MCP server that lets Claude answer questions about an online shop's sales and returns data.

**Northwind Home is a fictional homeware store.** All the data is generated by `shop-data/make_data.py` with a fixed seed. No real customers or orders are involved.

| Folder | What it is |
|---|---|
| `shop-data/` | The participant kit: pre-work README, `PROMPTS.md`, the data, the setup test server, and finished code for every stage |
| `debug-demo/` | Three deliberately broken servers for the debugging block |
| `hosted/` | A read-only copy that runs over HTTP, deployed for anyone whose laptop setup fails (no `save_note`) |

**Stack:** Python 3.11+, [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com) 4.1.0, and SQLite.

**Start here:** `shop-data/README.md`.

## Run it

```bash
cd shop-data
uv sync
uv run finished/stage3_server.py   # waits silently for an app to connect: that's correct
```

Test it without Claude:

```bash
npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.11.0 uv --directory . run finished/stage3_server.py
```

The Inspector needs Node 22.19 or newer.
